deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall 2027 are due December 15, 2026.

gre_general.value: CS strongly recommends the GRE General, unlike most RPI programmes where it is optional.
gre_general.quote: Strongly recommended for all Computer Science and Cognitive Science programs

gre_subject.value: CS has no subject-test rule on the page.

supervisor.value: The page says PhD students work with faculty advisers but does not state a supervisor rule for admission.

funding.value: Most CS graduate students receive teaching or research assistantships with tuition and a stipend.
funding.quote: Most CS graduate students receive financial support as teaching or research assistants

also.quote: These assistantships provide both tuition and a stipend, and guarantee funding for the duration of the PhD studies

entry_route.value: A PhD can be taken with or without a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: It is possible to obtain a PhD with or without an MS degree

notes: Financial aid consideration needs all materials by January 1 for fall admission (CS page, no year given); the December 15, 2026 doctoral deadline is earlier.
